Hygon Information Technology.why: China's x86-compatible server CPU designer: sells Hygon 7000 / 5000 series CPUs and DCU accelerators to major domestic server makers for servers and data centers, so AI and data-center CPU demand drives its revenue
Hygon Information Technology.evidence: Hygon Information Technology 2026 Half-Year Report (08-14-2026): main business is 'high-end processors used in servers, workstations and other computing and storage devices'; main customers are 'a few major domestic server makers'

players.product: x86-compatible server CPUs (Hygon 7000 / 5000 / 3000 series) and DCU GPGPU accelerators (8000 series) for servers and data centers

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 9.099 billion, up 66.52% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1.798 billion (+49.69%). The company attributed growth to fast AI development and rapidly growing demand for domestic high-end chips, expanding the market for its high-end processors.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Operating cash flow was an outflow of RMB 427.5 million (inflow of RMB 2.177 billion a year earlier) because the company enlarged stocking to secure supply and capture market opportunities; inventory RMB 7.518 billion at period end (20.86% of total assets) and prepayments to suppliers RMB 4.771 billion, mainly from strategic stocking.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: DCU: Hygon has adapted and optimised its DCU for more than 400 mainstream large models including DeepSeek, Qwen3, Hunyuan and Zhipu; its DAS software integrates over 2,000 operators; DCU customers include government departments, state-owned banks, telecom operators and internet companies. Its open HSL bus interconnect protocol targets super-node scale-up and scale-out; its Guanghe ecosystem has more than 6,000 partners.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company view: agentic AI drives server CPU demand - it writes that the CPU-to-GPU ratio is converging from 1:8 toward 1:1 or lower and that CPU core demand rises sharply with many concurrent agents; it keeps raising core count, frequency and memory bandwidth of its CPUs for agent workloads, and its CSV secure virtualisation reached version 3.0.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Risks the company states: its main customers are concentrated among a few major domestic server makers; its suppliers (foundries, OSATs, IP and EDA vendors) are concentrated and some are hard to replace, including because of geopolitics and the company being on the entity list; rising upstream raw-material prices.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D investment RMB 2.652 billion in H1 2026 (+55.05%), 29.15% of revenue; R&D staff 3,007 (80.83% of employees), developing the next-generation Hygon general-purpose processor and new DCU technology.
